title: Software developers and programmers
broad_category: Natural and applied sciences and related occupations
main_duties: Write, modify, integrate and test software code
Maintain existing computer programs by making modifications
Identify and communicate technical problems, processes and solutions
Prepare reports, manuals and documentation on the status, operation and maintenance of software
Assist in the collection and documentation of user's requirements

title: Software engineers and designers
broad_category: Natural and applied sciences and related occupations
main_duties: Collect and document users' requirements and develop logical and physical specifications
Research, evaluate and synthesize technical information to design, develop and test computer-based systems
Develop data, process and network models to optimize architecture

title: Web developers and programmers
broad_category: Natural and applied sciences and related occupations
main_duties: Write, modify, integrate and test website related code
Prepare mock-ups and storyboards
Create and optimize web content and architecture

title: Administrative assistants
main_duties: Prepare, key in, edit and proofread correspondence and documents
Open and distribute mail and other materials
Schedule and confirm appointments and meetings
Answer telephone and electronic enquiries

title: Accounting technicians and bookkeepers
main_duties: Keep financial records and establish, maintain and balance various accounts
Post journal entries and reconcile accounts
Prepare trial balance and bookkeeping reports

title: Nurse aides, orderlies and patient service associates
main_duties: Serve meal trays and feed patients
Transport patients
Take patients' blood pressure, temperature and pulse

title: Registered nurses and registered psychiatric nurses
main_duties: Assess patients to identify appropriate nursing interventions
Collaborate with members of an interdisciplinary health team
Administer medications and treatments

title: Early childhood educators and assistants
broad_category: Education, law and social, community and government services
main_duties: Develop and implement child-care programs
Lead activities by telling stories, teaching songs and preparing crafts
Observe children and discuss progress with supervisors and parents

title: Welders and related machine operators
broad_category: Trades, transport and equipment operators and related occupations
main_duties: Operate manual or semi-automatic welding equipment
Read and interpret welding blueprints
Examine welds and ensure they meet standards

title: Transport truck drivers
broad_category: Trades, transport and equipment operators and related occupations
main_duties: Operate and drive straight or articulated trucks
Plan trip logistics and obtain required documentation
Perform pre-trip inspections
